statement.essentials: The model is built from one donated body (the Visible Human Project), with some structures drawn by hand where scans cannot show them, and a generic face.
statement.anatomy: Bones, glands and muscles are segmented from the Visible Human male CT; the facial nerve, small vessels, the gland's deep portion and the face surface are authored to cited anatomy; the tumour is illustrative.

limitations: One individual; authored parts follow published ranges but are not measured from this body. See the QC log.
